name: hwahap
description: Turn an implementation request into a plan you confirm, then build, test, review, and open a draft pull request autonomously.

interface.shortDescription: Plan it with you, then build it without you.
interface.longDescription: Hwahap runs one implementation request end to end: it investigates the repository itself, puts every material decision to you with a recommendation and its evidence, freezes the plan once you confirm a digest-bound challenge, and then implements, tests, and reviews each unit on its own branch until a draft pull request is ready. It judges success from git state and exit status rather than from what any agent claims, and it never merges.
defaultPrompt: Add a dry-run flag to the apply command.
Refactor the settings loader so configuration comes from one place.
